'''XA-LX''', nicknamed '''"Exalex"''' by [[Ello Asty]], was an [[astromech droid]] in service to the [[Resistance]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] with the [[First Order]]. During the Resistance's [[Battle of Starkiller Base|attack]] on [[Starkiller Base]], she flew with Asty and was [[Death|killed]].<ref name="Poe Dameron 28" />
